notes.title: 17/08/2025 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A small update has just been released for Oaths of Light. Here’s what’s been fixed:

- Resolved an issue during a cutscene where you have choice between attacking a boar or the mysterious mushroom.
- Restored the quest "A Little Training" for the NPC Eddy in Reimber Village.

Thank you all for your continued feedback — it really helps us improve the game!

notes.title: New introduction
notes.content:
Hello!

I’m excited to share this update with you. It’s the first of many that I’ll be releasing in 2025 to enhance the game's quality before we begin working on the second chapter of the adventure. All of this is possible thanks to your incredible and valuable feedback, thank you!

[h1]First of all, a brand-new start screen![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39831165/d6a5d791747947d47e799b11610aaf1bcaabe19d.gif[/img]

First integration of the new user interface, which also includes the much-requested difficulty settings feature. While it’s not fully functional yet, it will allow you in the future to adjust the game for fewer encounters and easier battles, giving you the option to enjoy the world of Oaths of Light at your own pace and however you prefer.

[h2]Reworked game introduction[/h2]
It’s a complete remake of the game’s introduction. It offers a better introduction to the world and mechanics at a much faster pace, while still keeping it concise and digestible.

[h3]Small details[/h3]
I’ve decided to add manpus to the game! They’ll help bring better expressiveness to the characters and make the dialogues much livelier!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39831165/1b2a0f17e77bd6021d5a845883a09148390d288c.gif[/img]


[h3]What's coming up next? [/h3]
My plan for 2025 is to complete the new user interface, along with quality of life improvements and level design updates. After that, I’ll continue working on the second chapter of our story.

I want to thank you all once again for the love and feedback you’ve given. I’m actively working on the game, so if you have anything you'd like to share or just want to say hi, [url=https://discord.com/invite/k5SXjU6bTf]join the Discord server[/url]!

See you soon!

notes.title: Twitch integration and new tutorial
notes.content:
The following changes have been applied to [b]Oaths of Light[/b]:

[list]
[*] Twitch Integration Update: During choices where the chat can vote, you now have 600 seconds to interact with your community and give them enough time to cast their votes. You can also end the vote at any moment if needed.
[*] Enhanced Tutorial: Thanks to your valuable feedback, a more complete and interactive combat tutorial has been added.
[*] Even more creatures to cuddle! New adorable creatures are waiting for you in Reimber Village and Gerlin Forest!
[/list]
Thank you for your precious feedback, and enjoy the game! 🎮✨

notes.title: Quality of life updates and improvements
notes.content:
Hello,

We have made the following changes to [b]Oaths of Light[/b]:

[list]
[*] Fixed some typos in both the English and French versions.
[*] Adjusted the game's audio mix and levels, with the addition of an option in the settings menu to separately control the levels of music and sound effects.
[*] Added an option to adjust the resolution in the settings.
[*] Even more animals are now cuddly!
[/list]

Good game~

notes.title: Bug Fix and QOL Update
notes.content:
Hello,

We have made the following changes to Oaths of Light:

[list]
[*] It is now possible to confirm selections in the menus using the [b]ENTER [/b]and [b]SPACE [/b]keys for players using a keyboard.
[*] The combat tutorial has been updated with more details to improve the understanding of blocking systems, skills, and the item bags.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the completion of the 'Passion Mushroom' quest in the Gerlin Forest.
[*] Fixed some of the in/out camera transitions that could trigger motion sickness.
[*] Fixed a few scalability issues on some UIs.
[*] Fixed a few collision bugs in map.
[*] Fixed a few typos in English and French version.
[*] Added Petting feature on some creatures.
[/list]

Thank you for your precious feedback, more QoL updates and exciting content is on the making!

notes.content:
Hey~

[*] Added an option to choose between fullscreen or windowed mode.
[/list]
